summary: A meeting can adopt the committee's slate together and then settle a contested seat separately.
realLife: The 26th District's draft minutes describe approval of the recommended slate followed by a separate endorsement vote between two candidates for another district court position.
inGame: needs: committee recommendation and unresolved contest.

turns.pulledBy: The members accept the reported slate.
turns.what: The chair then calls the unresolved race.
turns.writesBack: The record distinguishes the group vote from the contested decision.

turns.pulledBy: Members want a name on the slate debated separately.
turns.what: The chair identifies that contest before taking the slate vote.
turns.writesBack: The secretary can tell which endorsement still needs action.
